subject: Evaluation timeline + commercial terms for pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@edgewave.com>, Ryan Patel <ryan.patel@edgewave.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Evaluation timeline + commercial terms for pilot

Hi Susan / Ryan —

Following up from our call today. Attached is a lightly edited evaluation plan that aligns checkpoints to commercial milestones so we can move from pilot -> paid production predictably. Key points:

- 6-week evaluation divided into 3 checkpoints (Week 2, Week 4, Week 6) with technical acceptance criteria per checkpoint.
- Pricing proposal is staged: evaluation credits for Weeks 1–2, followed by a discounted transition rate if EdgeWave meets ramp criteria by Week 4.
- We can offer a one-time onboarding credit of $12k for signed commitment within 30 days of pilot completion.

Request: please confirm the Week 4 ramp target (suggested: 50% of committed Q1 throughput) and whether your procurement needs a vendor packet before we send a formal SOW.

Attaching: EdgeWave_MAP_v2.pdf (evaluation plan v2).

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call if you prefer to walk through the checkpoints.

Best,
Marissa

From: Susan Lee <susan.lee@edgewave.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 12:47:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation timeline + commercial terms for pilot

Marissa —

Thanks for the doc and the call recap. A few clarifying questions from our side:

1) The Week 4 ramp target: 50% of committed Q1 throughput sounds reasonable, but procurement will want the exact definition (avg RT tokens / minute or concurrent sessions?). Can you make that explicit?
2) Is the onboarding credit conditioned on a signed commercial contract or a PO? Our legal prefers PO-based commitments.
3) We also need a standard vendor security questionnaire — do you have an SOC2 summary and data retention policy to share?

I attached EdgeWave's vendor intake checklist for reference (we'll send procurement contact details if this looks good). Also please include any revised pricing sheet so we can circulate internally.

Best,
Susan
Susan Lee
Director, Applied ML — EdgeWave Inc
susan.lee@edgewave.com

Attachment: EdgeWave_Vendor_Intake.pdf (application/pdf, 64KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Lee <susan.lee@edgewave.com>, Ryan Patel <ryan.patel@edgewave.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation timeline + commercial terms for pilot (pricing proposal v3)

Folks — looping in pricing details and a more explicit ramp definition. See Pricing_Term_Sheet_v3.xlsx attached. Summary here:

- Ramp definition: "Week 4 ramp" = 7-day trailing average token throughput measured in peak business hour window, or 50% of committed concurrent sessions (we will pick one metric with your ops team). We'll formalize in the SOW.
- Evaluation pricing: free credits covering up to 200k tokens across Weeks 1–2; overage billed at evaluation rate.
- Transition discount: if the Week 4 ramp target is met, EdgeWave receives a 15% discount on the first 3 months post-pilot (applies to model serving compute only), and reserved capacity pricing starts month 2.
- Commit schedule option A (preferred): 12-month reserved with 3-month ramp clause and quarterly reviews. Option B: 6-month pilot->month-to-month production with higher unit rates.

Notes for negotiation: we can increase onboarding credit to $15k if EdgeWave signs a PO for Option A within 21 days of pilot completion. If procurement insists on PO rather than signature, we can accept PO with a short lead time.

Marissa/Priyom — recommend we present Option A + reduced onboarding credit to procurement and highlight the 15% immediate discount on compute as the primary commercial incentive tied to the MAP checkpoint.

Attachment: Pricing_Term_Sheet_v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 24KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@edgewave.com>, Ryan Patel <ryan.patel@edgewave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation timeline + commercial terms for pilot

Hi Susan / Ryan —

Thanks for the quick review. Per Karthik's note above and after internal alignment, here's what we'd like to lock in for the pilot -> production path so procurement can review a single, clean set of terms:

1) Ramp metric: we will use 7-day trailing average token throughput during peak business hour as the objective metric. We will document sampling windows in the SOW.
2) Promotion: meet the Week 4 ramp => 15% discount on serving compute for months 1–3 of production.
3) Onboarding credit: $15,000 credit applied at invoice reconciliation if EdgeWave issues a PO for Option A (12-month reserved) within 21 days of pilot completion. If EdgeWave prefers PO-first, we can accept that instead of signature.
4) Security packet: attaching our SOC2 Lite summary and data retention excerpt (we can provide full SOC2 report under NDA).

Next steps: please confirm procurement contact and whether PO or standard signature flow is required. If procurement wants a PO path, we'll provide a short-form SOW + PO reference sheet.

If this is acceptable, I'll ask legal to prepare a short SOW and routing for procurement.

Best,
Marissa
